purpose: Nine unranked exploration kits; components may be selected separately or mixed. No cast, setting, plot or canon is approved by this document.

image_contract.characters: One new adult per image, one readable full-body silhouette and expressive face, one held item from this kit's equipment card. Clothing closes into large practical shapes. No alternate costume, duplicate person, extra weapon or accessory inventory.
image_contract.settings: One location per image; three principal spatial masses, one clear usable route and one practical function. Empty of featured characters and monsters so the location can be assessed independently. No crowd or tiny decorative inventory.
image_contract.creatures: One whole creature in an unobstructed three-quarter stance or flight; all named limbs separated and countable. One pose, no evolution chart, duplicates or effect cloud hiding anatomy.
image_contract.equipment: Exactly three separate functional objects on quiet ground, with generous space between them, at useful illustrative scales rather than misleading common scale. One object per item, no detail insets, exploded parts, free-floating duplicate handles or lettering. Labels and functions are external reader text.
image_contract.shared_exclusions: No Iven/Mara, red-haired poet sleeves with plum waistcoat, default ceramic vest/magenta-trouser cast, jellyfish-turtle, canal sluice, mandatory pairing, ornate filler, interface glyphs or baked-in words. Preserve each referenced rendering treatment, not its original cast or scene.

visual_rules: Precise tapered contour and crisp clean action-manhwa shapes; refined adult faces with limited soft modeling inside clearly bounded shadow masses, economical highlights and selective cyan edge light.
Indigo concrete and black glass; pearl workwear; cyan only on energized surfaces, one small scarlet safety accent.
Architecture uses a slab, a suspended span and one cable; avoid signage forests and floating interface graphics.
kits.linking_rule: Bridge cables collect atmospheric charge. Homes receive equal evening allotments; glass geckos graze spilled charge, so neglected insulation turns a public walkway into feeding ground.

characters.name: Sera Venn
characters.body: Short, lean, slight stoop, wiry hands and a narrow triangular silhouette.
characters.face: Deep brown skin, long hooked nose, hooded eyes, prominent cheekbones and fine smile lines; close silver crop with a squared hairline.
characters.costume: Pearl straight knee coat with a single large diagonal black shoulder panel, split back for climbing, charcoal narrow trousers and flat insulated boots; one scarlet cuff tab, no jewelry.
characters.occupation: Live-line inspector and veteran bridge rescuer
characters.personality: Dry, exacting, secretly indulgent toward mistakes honestly admitted.
characters.motive: Keep her block's lights running without hiding the utility's neglected repairs.
characters.pose: Low balanced step onto a plain ledge, long coat making one sharp triangular shape behind her; one gloved hand aims the insulated clamp forward to catch a live cable, other arm extends for balance. Fierce amused eyes; elderly action-lead presence, whole body and tool visible.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The insulated clamp catches and pins a whipping charged cable while her body stays outside its sweep.

characters.name: Tovan Pell
characters.body: Tall, broad, soft-bellied and thick-legged; square stable silhouette rather than a muscular hero taper.
characters.face: Warm light-brown skin, broad rounded nose, round cheeks, a gap between the front teeth and close dark curls; no beard.
characters.costume: Indigo sleeveless utility smock over a pale gray fitted long-sleeve shirt, wide black work trousers, white rubber-soled shoes; no waist cords.
characters.personality: Patient, friendly and stubborn about unfair rules.
characters.motive: Keep a public lift open for neighbors the ration office has written off.
characters.pose: Broad relaxed stance, lifting the single folded rescue sling by its central grip at thigh level; a warm challenging grin.

everyday_setting.name: Evening lift landing
everyday_setting.route: Open dry bridge deck leads directly to a large unmarked lift door.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: A single cyan strip beneath the bench marks its available charge; only two simple socket recesses.

dangerous_setting.name: Uninsulated service span
dangerous_setting.route: Continuous deck remains visible between two stout handrails; the loose cable crosses the far end.
dangerous_setting.danger: A small hard cyan contact glow on the broken cable identifies the electrical hazard without concealing the walkway.

creature.name: Charge gecko
creature.size: Two-meter body excluding tail, shoulder at an adult knee
creature.body: One low wedge-shaped smoked-glass reptile with a broad blunt head, two large cyan disc eyes and four thick splayed feet with three broad pads each; one narrow cyan charge line inside the torso. Large transparent planes, no ornamental facets.

topology.other: Exactly four splayed legs; one thick tapering tail, no frill, fins, antennae or extra claws.

creature.behavior: Climbs the undersides of bridges on its four broad pad feet and absorbs leaking charge through its belly; when startled, plants its feet and discharges through the tail tip.
creature.display_pose: Low three-quarter stance on a single slab with all four legs and the one complete tapering tail separated; no electricity cloud hiding anatomy.

equipment.name: Insulated cable clamp
equipment.form: A black C-shaped jaw with a single long pearl rubber handle and one scarlet lock button.
equipment.function: Temporarily isolates a damaged charged cable.

equipment.name: Folded rescue sling
equipment.form: One compact indigo U-shaped padded sling with a rigid central carry grip; its two straps remain neatly folded against the body.
equipment.function: Seats a stranded lift passenger for a controlled manual lowering.

equipment.name: Charge tile
equipment.form: A palm-sized pearl rectangle with two brass contacts and one narrow cyan inset.
equipment.function: Carries one household's evening charge allotment; the inset goes dark when exhausted.

kits.possible_conflict: The shortest lift repair would shut off a whole block's heat while a gecko feeds on the fault.
kits.crossmix_note: Its utility politics and rescue tools fit17's survey settlement or05's repair co-op; translate materials and power source rather than carrying neon into every style.

kits.rendering_label: Warm outlined painting (observed reference; old intent label was kinetic color manga)
visual_rules: Warm dark expressive contours over broad painted ochre light and cool blue shadows; confident faces with restrained surface texture.
Chalk plaster, red canvas, green bamboo and dull brass; large sail triangles, never a web of little kites.
Bright sunny space, at most one dominant sail per location; wind expressed through a few large cloth curves.
kits.linking_rule: Roof sails pull the neighborhood's flour mills and shade its communal ovens. Wind belongs to the block; stealing airflow leaves a neighboring roof hungry and overheated.

characters.name: Lale Rusk
characters.body: Very tall and lanky, long forearms, narrow hips, slightly knock-kneed resting stance.
characters.face: Deep warm-brown skin, long rectangular face, wide-set eyes, large ears and broad straight nose; a short black fan of tight curls above closely cut sides.
characters.costume: Sunflower sleeveless long tunic split only to the knee, fitted blue work trousers, plain green canvas shoes; one broad red shoulder yoke, no braid or wraps.
characters.occupation: Communal sail rigger and aerial duelist
characters.personality: Blunt, impatient with ceremony, delighted by a good mechanical puzzle.
characters.motive: Give the small roofs a fair share of wind.
characters.pose: One long stride balanced on a low broad roof block, red shoulder yoke and split yellow tunic making one sail-like triangle; green tension jack held diagonally forward in one hand, free hand balancing. Bright challenging grin, whole figure visible.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The opposed hooks catch a taut line or an opponent’s pole; the sliding collar locks the catch while the rigger redirects it with body weight.

characters.name: Berto Senn
characters.body: Short, very round and broad-hipped with strong calves; a calm bell-shaped silhouette.
characters.face: Freckled fair skin, small snub nose, heavy cheeks, thick straight eyebrows and a neat salt-and-pepper moustache; bald crown with a close dark fringe.
characters.costume: Plain tomato-red knee apron over a sky-blue short-sleeve shirt, cream straight trousers and brown clogs; no chef hat or hanging utensil collection.
characters.motive: Keep the communal bread price fixed through a poor wind season.
characters.pose: Feet planted apart, one hand carrying a single round insulated oven paddle with its disk fully visible; amused sideways smile.

everyday_setting.name: Shared shade oven roof
everyday_setting.route: Wide uncluttered stone floor connects the stair opening and oven mouth.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: A simple vertical mill shaft beside the oven connects visibly to the sail's one thick rope.

dangerous_setting.name: Gust gap
dangerous_setting.route: A single narrow fixed plank joins the ledges; both landing points remain readable.
dangerous_setting.danger: A slack heavy sail threatens to sweep across the plank; no dense airborne debris.

creature.name: Gust hare
creature.size: Large dog, ears reach an adult's waist
creature.body: A low sandy ceramic body with simple blue glaze on two huge leaf-shaped ears, blunt rabbit face and large round dark eyes.

topology.other: Two short forelegs and two long folded hindlegs; one small round tail. Ears are ears, not extra wings.

creature.behavior: Turns its broad ears into the wind and bounds between hot roofs; seeks oven warmth when the wind drops.
creature.display_pose: A settled three-quarter crouch with all four feet visible, ears angled asymmetrically but unbroken.

equipment.name: Sail tension jack
equipment.form: One short green bamboo bar with two opposed brass hooks and a red sliding collar.
equipment.function: Tightens a sail line without cutting off the neighboring roof's airflow.

equipment.name: Insulated oven paddle
equipment.form: A round ochre ceramic disk on one stout red wooden handle, a broad dark insulating band at the grip.
equipment.function: Moves a hot bread tray while shielding the cook's hand.

equipment.name: Wind-share vane
equipment.form: One simple blue triangular fin on a brass pivot above a weighted square foot.
equipment.function: Shows whether a roof is blocking its neighbor's prevailing wind; no numbers or dial text.

kits.possible_conflict: A rich roof doubles its sail and a gust hare starts sleeping in the now-cold public oven.
kits.crossmix_note: Shared wind and large canvas geometry can join18's orchard; keep02's painted sun and grounded craft instead of importing18's elastic anatomy.

kits.rendering_label: Textured painting (observed reference; old intent label was retro cel animation)
visual_rules: Opaque textured paint, firm drawn edges where needed, broad weathered color planes and expressive dimensional adult faces.
Faded olive canvas, rust steel, blue enamel and cream orchard bark; wear concentrated at contacts, not all-over decorative grime.
One rail, one tree mass and one useful machine per scene; no tangle of gears or tiny rivets.
kits.linking_rule: The orchard's iron-rich roots grow around abandoned rails. Furnace boars digest rotten fruit and rust into fertile slag; the co-op must leave both food sources for them rather than sell every rail.

characters.name: Orrel Dunn
characters.body: Pear-shaped, heavy middle, narrow sloping shoulders and big hands; short sturdy legs.
characters.face: Ruddy medium-brown skin, broad flattened nose, a deeply cleft chin and sleepy eyes; thick gray sideburns, clean chin and sparse swept gray hair.
characters.costume: Faded denim long work coat, rust knit crewneck, olive trousers and plain mud boots; no overalls or mechanical gauntlets.
characters.motive: Prove living soil is worth more than a final scrap sale.
characters.pose: One hand resting a long two-tined soil fork upright beside his body, other on hip; knowing small smile.

characters.name: Nima Cress
characters.body: Tall, lean and sinewy with narrow shoulders, long neck and straight runner's legs.
characters.face: Olive skin, heart-shaped face, convex nose, alert dark eyes and a small angular jaw; straight dark hair cut to a blunt jaw-length bob, no pompadour.
characters.costume: Cream high-neck zip work jacket with a sharply cropped front and one long split back panel, broad blue chest block, rust narrow cargo trousers with only two large pockets, black lace boots. Strong long diagonal silhouette, no cape or ornament.
characters.occupation: Rail clinic medic and emergency route runner
characters.personality: Brisk, inventive, easily exasperated by preventable injuries.
characters.motive: Keep the clinic reachable while the old line is dismantled.
characters.pose: Long planted braking step with the coat back sweeping as a single cream shape; one hand grips the closed blue medical case low as a counterweight, the other reaches forward to pull someone clear. Focused fearless grin; no second person depicted.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The rigid medical case protects her forearm while she slides past hot rail edges; she uses its weight to arrest a sprint and reach a casualty.

everyday_setting.name: Orchard loading halt
everyday_setting.route: A clear flat aisle parallels a single embedded rail and leads to a small clinic doorway.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: One shallow rust trough contains dark compost beside the tree; fruit remains clustered in large simple masses.

dangerous_setting.name: Hot slag cutting
spatial_masses: A rail cutting between two earth banks
dangerous_setting.route: A pale maintenance shelf remains visible along one bank.
dangerous_setting.danger: Heat softens a single rail across the route; isolate the glow to the pool, no sparks filling the view.

creature.name: Furnace boar
creature.size: Small ox, shoulder at an adult's lower chest
creature.body: Heavy dark charcoal boar with a rounded rust-red iron back plate and one broad blue-enamel-looking snout; small black eyes, one visible warm vent slit along each side.

topology.other: Four short cloven legs, two small ears, one short straight tail; no tusks, claws, pincers or train segments.

creature.behavior: Roots along rails, grinds rust and fallen fruit, and deposits warm fertile slag; charges only when blocked from shade.
creature.display_pose: Quiet three-quarter rooting stance with snout above ground and all four legs separated.

equipment.name: Root release fork
equipment.form: One long pale wooden shaft with exactly two thick blunt rust-steel tines.
equipment.function: Lifts roots off a rail without chopping the tree's feeder network.

equipment.name: Rail clinic case
equipment.form: One compact blue enamel clamshell case with one top grip and a broad cream latch, closed.
equipment.function: Keeps bandages and heat dressings dry on orchard rounds; no medical insignia needed.

equipment.name: Slag scoop
equipment.form: A shallow triangular steel scoop with one short insulated olive handle and a thick pouring lip.
equipment.function: Transfers cooled fertile slag to tree beds; its broad rim makes the direction of pouring obvious.

kits.possible_conflict: Scrap buyers remove the last feeding rail and the hungry boars root under the clinic platform.
kits.crossmix_note: Repair labor and useful worn objects combine readily with01 or15; its organic rust ecology can be repainted without importing the old centipede or mechanic.

visual_rules: Large pure black and white masses, decisive brush contour, sparse dry brush and a single hot-pink accent.
Concrete, black waterproof rubber, white paper pulp; materials distinguished by shape and edge rather than gray airbrush.
Dry shelves and reflective flood planes form simple horizontal layers; one lamp or one opening supplies the light.
kits.linking_rule: Each household stores a paper copy of its tenancy in a municipal rain archive. Drain lungs consume softened pulp, so flood recovery means protecting both legal memory and the city's waste-eating animals.

characters.name: Eda Flint
characters.body: Compact, square and muscular, short neck and broad forearms; upright rectangular silhouette.
characters.face: A broad mature face, deep-set narrow eyes, a blunt nose bent slightly at the bridge and a strong underbite; close black buzz cut, one white temple patch.
characters.costume: White boxy rain jacket with black elbow panels, black straight trousers and tall plain rubber boots; one pink fastening tab, no apron or suspenders.
characters.occupation: Document recovery officer and flood pursuit specialist
characters.personality: Skeptical, decisive and unexpectedly tender with frightened people.
characters.motive: Save residents' records before a landlord can declare the flooded block unoccupied.
characters.pose: Square low defensive stance, one hand extending the long lifting paddle as a broad shield between her face and a threat outside frame; free hand open behind her, rain jacket forming a blunt white wedge. Unflinching focused stare; complete tool and feet visible.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The broad paddle probes unstable floors and blocks a drain lung’s intake without cutting it; its long grip keeps her safely outside the animal’s suction.

characters.name: Perrin Hush
characters.body: Extremely tall and gaunt, pointed elbows, forward-set shoulders and large flat feet.
characters.face: Long narrow face, large drooping nose, close-set round eyes and a sparse straight moustache; high forehead with flat dark side-parted hair.
characters.costume: Long black sleeveless waterproof tabard over a plain white turtleneck, cropped black trousers and square white-soled boots; pink inner collar only.
characters.motive: Recover the workshop lease that proves his clients own their repair cooperative.
characters.pose: One hand holding a closed flat white drying press at his side, free fingers counting an objection; worried comic concentration.

everyday_setting.name: Rain archive intake
everyday_setting.route: Dry white floor runs from the broad entrance to the counter.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: Three large unlettered document bundles sit in separate drying slots; pink tabs are the only color.

dangerous_setting.name: Submerged records room
dangerous_setting.route: One raised maintenance strip leads between shelves to the door.
dangerous_setting.danger: The lowest shelf sags into the water; floating pages gather in one distinct raft, no wallpaper of small text.

creature.name: Drain lung
creature.size: Two meters long, knee-high when inflated
creature.body: One low smooth black oval bladder with exactly six transverse white bands, a flat blunt head and two white slit eyes; one broad intake mouth at the front.

topology.other: Six surface bands are markings, not projecting ribs or limbs; no umbrella spokes or eel tail.

creature.behavior: Pulses water through its body to glide and vacuum decaying paper; emits a low whistle when a hard object obstructs its intake.
creature.display_pose: One complete inflated body above a thin white water reflection; mouth and six body bands readable, no surrounding pulp cloud.

equipment.name: Paper lifting paddle
equipment.form: One wide flat perforated white blade on a long black handle, with three large drainage slots.
equipment.function: Slides under a sodden document bundle without tearing it.

equipment.name: Portable drying press
equipment.form: A closed white rectangular sandwich press with one broad black perimeter strap and pink latch.
equipment.function: Keeps a rescued bundle flat between absorbent boards.

equipment.name: Drain whistle
equipment.form: A single short bent white horn with one black rubber mouthpiece and a wide oval bell.
equipment.function: Mimics the drain lung's blockage call to draw it away from a shelf without harming it.

kits.possible_conflict: A legally crucial bundle is stuck in a drain lung's mouth while the archive's pumps are ordered off.
kits.crossmix_note: Public-record stakes and salvage equipment fit17's shifting settlement; noir can depict another world's institutions without making all its species black eels.

visual_rules: Crisp expressive anatomy, tapered black line, fine directional hatching on faces and cloth, and strong black shapes on white; vermilion reserved for brake surfaces and civic route markers.
Cast concrete, black rubber, unpainted steel; simple curved berms and blunt wedge-shaped tools.
Action comes from body weight and slope; no continuous speed-line background or swarm creature.
kits.linking_rule: A hillside city moves freight downhill by gravity. Route crews earn status for controlled stops, not speed; spring rams feed on the vibration of braking lanes and can spoil a clean descent.

characters.name: Daska Vale
characters.body: Very tall, thick-waisted and heavily muscled with broad thighs, a deep chest and large working hands.
characters.face: Square mature face, broad nose, small sharp eyes and a heavy brow; short straight dark hair in a severe bowl crop, one missing front tooth visible in her grin.
characters.costume: Black sleeveless square-neck work suit with white shoulder pads integrated into cloth, calf-length wide legs and flat red brake soles; no wraps or giant boxing gloves.
characters.motive: Keep freight certification open to workers who cannot afford guild tuition.
characters.pose: Wide low stance with one red brake wedge carried in the lowered right hand, other hand relaxed; fierce approving grin.

characters.name: Kio Noll
characters.body: Short and slight, narrow shoulders, thin wrists and notably long shins; adult proportions, not a child.
characters.face: Fine oval adult face, prominent ears, straight narrow nose, wide serious eyes and uneven thick eyebrows; soft black curls cropped above the ears.
characters.costume: White short-sleeve high-collar referee tunic, loose black knee-length shorts over white leggings, black low shoes and one plain red chest stripe.
characters.occupation: Apprentice route judge and counterstep fighter
characters.personality: Earnest, analytical and unexpectedly daring when someone is hurt.
characters.motive: Make stop-distance rulings fair instead of protecting famous crews.
characters.pose: Elastic wide sidestep on a plain sloped slab, one knee bent and the other leg long; single route paddle raised across his outside shoulder ready to parry, free hand extended for balance. Sudden sharp competitive smile, adult wiry anatomy.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The rigid route paddle signals a stop, then serves as a short parrying blade; his advantage is foot placement and redirection, not heavy armor.

everyday_setting.name: Freight practice bowl
everyday_setting.route: A wide descending lane ends in a clearly flat red stopping strip.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: One empty simple two-wheel freight cart sits parked away from the lane; no crowd or text.

dangerous_setting.name: Blind switchback
spatial_masses: A black overhang masking its upper entry
dangerous_setting.route: The lane's two continuous edges show its downhill bend and final flat stopping pocket.
dangerous_setting.danger: One cracked rubber brake slab has lifted at the curve's exit; no cliffs or extra track forks needed.

creature.name: Spring ram
creature.body: Compact white barrel torso on four powerful black hock legs, blunt ram face with two simple backward-curving horns and a single red throat patch; head thrust low in a competitive springing silhouette.

topology.other: Two forelegs and two larger hindlegs, each with one broad hoof; one short blunt tail. No additional hands, fins or appendages.

creature.behavior: Crouches on braking strips to absorb their vibration, then releases the stored bounce in one long leap; will follow a firmly tapped rhythm.
creature.display_pose: Low three-quarter ready-to-spring stance with all four legs and hooves separately readable, both horns clear of the shoulders and short tail visible.

equipment.name: Brake wedge
equipment.form: One thick red triangular rubber wedge with a single black recessed handgrip on its rear face.
equipment.function: Seats under a freight wheel to arrest an uncontrolled cart.

equipment.name: Route judge's paddle
equipment.form: One thick rigid white rectangular blade with a black center reinforcement bar on a short red handle; no printed marks.
equipment.function: Gives an unmistakable stop signal at the blind turn.

equipment.name: Rhythm striker
equipment.form: One compact steel tuning fork with two thick black tines and a red rubber grip.
equipment.function: Taps a steady beat into the track to lure a spring ram off a brake strip.

kits.possible_conflict: A sponsor demands a faster freight demonstration just as a spring ram nests on the last safe stopping strip.
kits.crossmix_note: Gravity logistics can join17's terraced city or01's lift district; the competitive civic culture is optional, not a compulsory tournament plot.

visual_rules: Dense controlled curved copperplate hatching and crosshatching describe rounded faces, wool folds and bronze volume; fine contour remains legible, parchment stays open around silhouettes and aged brass is the only accent.
Limestone, plain wool, hammered bronze and dark cork; decoration limited to the logic of joints and handles.
One monumental bell or pipe elbow carries each location; no maze of gears or brocade costume noise.
kits.linking_rule: Low bells drive resonant pumps that heat the public baths. Quiet hours protect the bronze hounds that sleep against warm pipes; excessive ringing makes them seize the pump housings.

characters.name: Halden Rue
characters.body: Broad, thick and gently stooped with a heavy stomach, strong forearms and short bowed legs.
characters.face: Wide wrinkled face, bulbous nose, heavy drooping eyelids and a short square white beard; full swept-back white hair, no bald head or long sculpted moustache.
characters.costume: Plain dark ankle-length felt coat with a broad parchment-colored square collar, stout boots and a single brass front clasp; no patterned fabric.
characters.personality: Kind, stubborn and very difficult to rush.
characters.motive: Keep the lowest district's baths warm without exhausting the pump animals.
characters.pose: One hand holding a short bell-damping mallet across his thigh, other spread in a patient explanation; gentle skeptical eyes.

characters.name: Vessa Orr
characters.body: Short and dense, muscular back and forearms, broad feet and a low triangular stance.
characters.face: Narrow wedge face, sharply upturned nose, small bright eyes and a long dimple in one cheek; straight dark hair shaved at the nape with a thick blunt fringe.
characters.costume: Parchment-toned fitted work tunic beneath a plain dark cropped leather shoulder bib, broad dark culottes and simple lace boots; no armor or corset lacing.
characters.occupation: Bell rigger and tactical resonator tracker
characters.personality: Restless, ingenious, proud of invisible reliable work.
characters.motive: Replace a dangerous cracked bell before the council buys another ceremonial one.
characters.pose: Low braced lunge with one broad trouser leg forward, short shoulder bib creating a compact armored-looking silhouette without armor; long pipe key held across the body from a single clear grip, jaw angled to catch a support pin. Intense delighted focus, whole figure visible.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The square key jaw catches a bell support pin as a pivot, letting her swing or brace clear of a charging hound without adding a weapon.

everyday_setting.name: Neighborhood warming hall
everyday_setting.route: A wide dry ledge runs around the bath directly to a plain door.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: A thin steam ribbon rises only where the pipe enters the water; the hall is a public utility, not a decorated palace.

dangerous_setting.name: Cracked low-bell chamber
dangerous_setting.route: The balcony connects a stair landing to one visible bell support socket.
dangerous_setting.danger: A single large crack runs from the bell lip upward; its displaced lip hangs close to the service route.

creature.name: Resonator hound
creature.size: Large calf, head at an adult's waist
creature.body: A smooth hollow bronze barrel chest, a long blunt dog muzzle with two dark slit eyes, thick cork-dark paws and one simple fan-shaped ear on each side.

topology.other: Four jointed dog legs, one short rigid tapering tail; no fins, clappers or extra appendages.

creature.behavior: Presses its chest to a warm pipe to sleep and damp vibration; painful ringing makes it clamp its muzzle over the source until quiet returns.
creature.display_pose: Standing still with four paws separated and neck extended toward one low pipe stub; body contour completely unobscured.

equipment.name: Damping mallet
equipment.form: One broad cylindrical cork head mounted on a short straight bronze handle.
equipment.function: Settles a ringing bell without cracking its lip.

equipment.name: Pipe key
equipment.form: One long flat bronze bar with a large square open jaw and a simple rounded grip end.
equipment.function: Turns the bath pump's square valve stem; the jaw shape visibly matches the job.

equipment.name: Quiet collar
equipment.form: One thick open C-shaped cork collar with a single brass toggle joining its ends.
equipment.function: Clamps around a vibrating pipe to reduce the sound that agitates a hound.

kits.possible_conflict: The council schedules a triumphal bell peal while the district's last functioning heat pump is surrounded by sleeping hounds.
kits.crossmix_note: Sound, public heat and repair ethics combine with05 or06; engraving may depict plain tools beautifully without forcing every world into ornate steampunk.

visual_rules: Uniform clean contour, flat terracotta/mint/cream/sky-blue color and sparse clear shadows; adult cartoon faces distinguished by construction.
Brick arches, white cut stone, mint painted wood and plain canvas; each stair has a visible start and landing.
Architecture remains intelligible with no impossible stair tangles; small details only where they reveal function.
kits.linking_rule: Stone beetles lift and settle loose foundations as they feed on mineral seams. Residents own access to a route, not a permanent doorway, so surveyors and masons must keep revising the public steps.

characters.name: Jun Tessel
characters.body: Very tall and angular, long neck, narrow flat chest and large knuckled hands; slight forward lean.
characters.face: Golden-brown skin, long horse-shaped face, prominent curved nose, small dark eyes and a deeply notched chin; smooth silver hair in a short wedge cut, no spectacles.
characters.costume: Mint sleeveless knee coat over a cream stand-collar shirt, terracotta straight trousers and simple black ankle boots; one broad functional coat pocket.
characters.occupation: Public route surveyor and frontier pathfinder
characters.motive: Keep a shifting neighborhood connected instead of letting officials abandon its oldest residents.
characters.pose: Long confident stride across one small clearly supported step gap, mint coat framing a tall narrow angular silhouette; one hand extends the folded level frame as a probe, the free arm balances. Inquisitive daring smile, entire figure and both supported feet visible.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The rigid folded frame tests a landing’s stability before she commits her weight; its attached plumb weight reveals a moving slab.

characters.name: Moss Rell
characters.body: Short and heavyset, broad shoulders, round abdomen and thick calves; grounded square stance.
characters.face: Fair rosy skin, round face, wide nose, small deep-set eyes, uneven front teeth and thick brows; straight black hair in a short asymmetrical crop.
characters.costume: Terracotta elbow-sleeve work smock with one wide mint shoulder panel, cream loose trousers, stout blue work shoes; no waistcoat, parka or map case.
characters.personality: Warm, methodical and fond of practical jokes.
characters.motive: Build a stair system neighbors can adjust themselves without paying the guild every month.
characters.pose: Single hand carrying one squat mint step jack at thigh height, other open toward the viewer; broad reassuring grin.

everyday_setting.name: Adjustable step court
everyday_setting.route: The stair clearly joins the open court and a raised doorway; no split routes.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: A single broad mint adjustment socket appears on the lowest step, large enough to understand at a glance.

dangerous_setting.name: Shifted arch foot
dangerous_setting.route: A single temporary wood bridge joins the slabs with both ends fully supported and visible.
dangerous_setting.danger: One arch foot has lifted out of its stone bed, leaving a clean readable vertical gap beside the route.

creature.name: Lift beetle
creature.size: Compact cart, back at an adult's waist
creature.body: One smooth mint-gray oval stone carapace, small cream wedge head, two round black eyes and a blunt shovel mouth; no trees, island or turtle dome.

topology.other: Exactly three pairs of thick angular stone legs, each with one broad flat foot; no roots or ornamental branches.

creature.behavior: Braces its six feet, lifts loose paving with its shell, and scrapes mineral grit underneath; slow and harmless unless a route collapses over it.
creature.display_pose: Elevated three-quarter stance with three near legs and three far feet clearly separated, one small paving slab resting on the shell without hiding its edge.

equipment.name: Folding level frame
equipment.form: One cream triangular frame with a single dark plumb cord hanging inside; the cord terminates in a small attached terracotta weight.
equipment.function: Checks whether a shifted landing is safe; attached weight is part of the same tool, not a separate card item.

equipment.name: Step jack
equipment.form: One squat mint U-shaped lifting body with a single large side screw and an integral top carry grip.
equipment.function: Raises one stair block so neighbors can reset its height.

equipment.name: Route bridge plank
equipment.form: One short cream plank with broad terracotta grip strips and a blunt locking hook at each end.
equipment.function: Spans a small new foundation gap and locks to matching step sockets.

kits.possible_conflict: A beetle moves the courthouse approach the night before residents must prove their right to the route.
kits.crossmix_note: Readable stairs and changing access combine with01's vertical utilities or06's records dispute; carry the spatial rule, not the old mapmaker or walking island.

visual_rules: Thick varied contour, big expressive adult faces, purposeful squash-and-stretch and two-step cel shadows.
Turquoise enamel, orange sailcloth, grass green and off-white wood; broad rounded masses with clear weight.
Cloud shapes remain simple and separate from creature anatomy; no tiny sparkles or pink ornamental noise.
kits.linking_rule: Cloud bison graze wet wind and release rain when settled. Orchard cooks predict weather from their appetite; windmill crews create quiet lee pockets so the herd will water crops rather than stampede through town.

characters.name: Fen Barlow
characters.body: Broad, very soft and heavy with a large belly, thick upper arms and surprisingly small feet; round teardrop silhouette.
characters.face: Dark brown skin, broad oval face, a large rounded nose, full lower lip and sleepy smiling eyes; close black hair with a small white forelock, clean-shaven.
characters.costume: Orange short-sleeve cook's tunic with a large turquoise square chest pocket, dark green straight trousers and pale slip-on work shoes; no singlet or gauntlets.
characters.personality: Mellow, playful and sharply observant beneath an absent-minded manner.
characters.motive: Feed travelers during storms without letting the orchard council hoard the rain.
characters.pose: Holding one broad turquoise wind ladle low and outward, free hand on belly; a delighted knowing smile.

characters.name: Ysra Pike
characters.body: Exceptionally tall and wiry, long hooked shoulders, very long hands and thin bowed legs; unmistakably adult and athletic.
characters.face: Pale freckled skin, long angular face, sharp triangular nose, enormous slanted eyebrows and a narrow chin; bright orange hair in a short spiky crop, not pink locs.
characters.costume: Turquoise long-sleeve cropped utility jacket closed at the neck, cream high-waisted wide trousers and green flat boots; one orange seat patch, no loose sash.
characters.occupation: Windmill climber and storm rescue challenger
characters.personality: Impatient, fearless at height and nervous in crowds.
characters.motive: Install a public storm shelter on a hill reserved for wealthy growers.
characters.pose: Exaggerated but grounded long-legged brace against a strong imaginary gust; one hand carries the single folded lee screen diagonally like a compact shield, the other points upward. Jacket and trouser shapes form a vivid zigzag; huge fearless grin.
characters.tactical_gear_use: The folded screen blocks a snapping sail; opened and braced on the ground it creates a calm pocket that redirects a frightened bison. No flight or extra carried tools.

everyday_setting.name: Orchard forecast kitchen
everyday_setting.route: A wide orange-earth path passes between stove and tree toward an open shelter door.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: One empty oversized rain bowl sits on the wall beneath the tree's drip edge.

dangerous_setting.name: Unbraked hill mill
dangerous_setting.route: A broad stepped service path winds once around the tower to a low access hatch.
dangerous_setting.danger: One torn orange sail hangs across the path; a single dark storm mass approaches from the exposed side.

creature.name: Cloud bison
creature.size: Broad ox, shoulder at an adult's chest
creature.body: One inflated turquoise bison body with a low heavy head, orange cheek pads, two small cream horns and a dark green underbelly; body remains smooth rather than made of cloud puffs.

topology.other: Four short powerful hoof legs; two small ears; one thin tail with a single rounded tip.

creature.behavior: Sniffs wet air, swells slightly before rain and kneels in sheltered grass to release a shower; loud sail snaps can send it running.
creature.display_pose: Planted three-quarter stance with four hooves separated, complete horns and a single tail, no rain cloud hiding the outline.

equipment.name: Wind ladle
equipment.form: One broad turquoise half-bowl with a long orange handle and a single large oval vent through the bowl.
equipment.function: Samples wind direction and catches the first rain to tell the cook when to cover the ovens.

equipment.name: Folded lee screen
equipment.form: One compact orange canvas rectangle folded onto a turquoise hinged U-frame, with its single carry handle visible.
equipment.function: Opens into a quiet windbreak to settle a cloud bison; show only the folded carried state.

equipment.name: Mill brake shoe
equipment.form: One thick cream curved wooden block with a broad green friction face and one integral orange loop grip.
equipment.function: Seats against the rotor rim to stop the mill before a storm tears its sail.

kits.possible_conflict: Growers keep the hill shelter closed during a storm and the thirsty herd heads toward the public kitchens.
kits.crossmix_note: Weather commons link naturally to02's shared sails; strong cartoon shape design can also refresh15's sound-sensitive animals without preserving either original monster.

visual_rules: Refined adult facial construction, thin clean contour, restrained silky gradients and large decisive black clothing shapes.
Bone ceramic, dull silver tools, black waxed fabric and crimson dye; only one botanical flourish on a creature, not on every costume and wall.
Pale open space, severe tailoring and one dark plant mass; eerie through posture and absence rather than gore or clutter.
kits.linking_rule: A living black reed makes permanent red dye only when left dormant through winter. Dye houses that force a second harvest wake walking root predators, so protecting workers also means refusing profitable year-round color.

characters.name: Ruth Sable
characters.body: Tall, lean and broad-shouldered with a long straight torso and strong hands; architectural rectangular silhouette.
characters.face: Very dark skin, shaved head, broad nose bridge, high wide cheekbones, deep-set amber-brown eyes and a small firm mouth; no split black-white hair.
characters.costume: Bone sleeveless straight high-neck coat over a black column dress slit only to the calf, flat silver-gray shoes and one narrow crimson interior facing; no jewelry or glove.
characters.occupation: Independent dye broker and reed-fencing rival
characters.personality: Controlled, persuasive and angry when courtesy is used to conceal cruelty.
characters.motive: Break the guild's forced-harvest contracts without abandoning workers who need wages now.
characters.pose: Elegant long forward fencing step, bone straight coat creating one severe pale slash against black; single closed reed shear held forward from its joined loop grip, free hand poised behind. Cool challenging half-smile, strong mature face, entire body and shear visible.
characters.tactical_gear_use: Closed blunt shear blades parry and redirect grasping roots; opened only for harvesting, they cut at a clean joint rather than tearing living stock.

characters.name: Ansel Voss
characters.body: Short, heavyset and soft-shouldered, thick neck and strong broad feet; oval silhouette beneath straight tailoring.
characters.face: Pale skin with a flushed nose, full jowls, small hooded eyes, broad curved nose and sparse short beard; receding gray hair brushed straight back.
characters.costume: Plain black calf-length waxed garden coat with a high folded white collar, charcoal roomy trousers and low black boots; one crimson cuff lining, no pleated fashion trousers or thorn whip.
characters.personality: Gentle, anxious and meticulously brave when others retreat.
characters.motive: Save the living root stock and clear the names of workers blamed for a forced bloom.
characters.pose: Carrying one closed bone ceramic dormancy jar by its single black top handle, other hand held quietly close; tired compassionate eyes.

everyday_setting.name: Winter dye exchange
spatial_masses: One broad unpatterned black cloth hung flat
everyday_setting.route: A clear pale floor leads straight from a plain doorway to the counter.
everyday_setting.functional_cue: One tightly bound bundle of dormant black reeds lies on the counter; no jars or flowers filling every shelf.

dangerous_setting.name: Forced bloom house
spatial_masses: A long raised bone-colored planting bed
A single opaque black hanging heat curtain
dangerous_setting.route: A narrow pale service aisle runs beside the bed to a visible closed metal door.
dangerous_setting.danger: One split planting-bed corner shows thick black roots pressing outward; red condensate runs in one stain, no gore or luminous fog.

creature.name: Wake-root
creature.size: Shoulder-high adult, four-foot stance about two meters wide
creature.body: One closed black teardrop bud held upright above a short knotted pale root hub; one smooth bone-white vertical face slit with two tiny dark eyes, crimson visible only between the bud's two main overlapping halves.

topology.other: Exactly four thick bent root legs ending in broad blunt tips; no fine root fringe, antlers or secondary tendrils. The two bud halves are body plates, not wings.

creature.behavior: Remains rooted during winter; forced heat wakes it to walk toward the warmest occupied room and wrap its four legs around the heat source.
creature.display_pose: Complete closed-bud three-quarter stance with all four root legs separately visible; one leg lifted slightly, no action effects or open-mouth explosion.

equipment.name: Reed shear
equipment.form: One long closed silver pruning shear, two blunt beak blades and two plain black loop handles joined at a single pivot.
equipment.function: Cuts a mature reed at one clean joint without shredding its living root.

equipment.name: Dormancy jar
equipment.form: One broad bone ceramic sealed jar with a low black lid, one integral arch handle and a crimson wax seam.
equipment.function: Keeps one root cutting cool and dormant during transport; no visible specimen or extra inner jars.

equipment.name: Heat shutter
equipment.form: One handheld rectangular black ceramic plate with a dull-silver rim and one insulated rear grip visible at its edge.
equipment.function: Blocks radiant heat while a gardener closes a forced-growth furnace; a practical barrier, not an ornate weapon shield.

kits.possible_conflict: The guild secretly heats the winter stock to fill a prestigious order, then calls the waking roots a worker sabotage attempt.
kits.crossmix_note: Dormancy, labor contracts and botanical materials can join05's co-op or06's legal-memory stakes; the fashion treatment need not dictate a young thin cast or a horror-only plot.

mixing_rule: All social rules and character relationships are optional design hypotheses, not exclusive pairing constraints. Any character, location, creature or gear may be explored with another rendering treatment or compatible world.
